mapper.select: SELECT id, content, embedding, metadata, status, version, replaces_id, created_at, updated_at, 1 - (embedding <=> CAST(#{vec} AS vector)) AS score FROM public.knowledge_chunks WHERE status = 'active' AND (metadata->>'expires_at' IS NULL OR (metadata->>'expires_at')::timestamptz > now()) ORDER BY embedding <=> CAST(#{vec} AS vector) LIMIT #{topK}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(1 - (embedding <=> CAST(#{vec} AS vector))), 0) FROM public.knowledge_chunks WHERE status = 'active'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.knowledge_chunks (content, embedding, metadata, status, version, replaces_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( #{content}, #{embedding, typeHandler=com.stockwise.handler.VectorTypeHandler}, #{metadata, typeHandler=com.stockwise.handler.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{status}, #{version}, #{replacesId}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE public.knowledge_chunks SET status = 'deprecated', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
